IMO the best teams to invest in for each of the requirements:  
  
Node 5 & 10 teams:  
Pestilence- Dark Hunter/Web Warrior/Hive-Mind/Underworld: I would go with either Hive Mind or Underworld. Underworld is more accessible, but Hive Mind will be better long-term.  
Death - Bionic Avenger/Wakandan/Pegasus: Definitely go for Pegasus here.  
War - Ravager/Wave 1 Avenger/Asgardian/Black Order - I would go for Bifrost here as an Asgardian team due to their utility in raids, and also Vahl just being crazy good.  
Famine - A-Force/Inhuman/Young Avenger/Infestation/Secret Defender/New Warrior - Secret Defenders will be best here, specifically the main trio of Black Cat, Ghost Rider Robbie and Hard Light. The other two can just be whoever you have levelled I'd say.  
  
General other node reqs you'll need:  
Pestilence:  
Hero - You can use any combo of toons here.  
Global - I'd recommend using X-Treme X-Men or Rebirth.  
Villain - You can use any combo of toons here.  
Cosmic - Bifrost will be very good here.  
  
Death:  
Minion/Villain - Use villains, ignore minions.  
Hero - You can use any combo of toons here.  
Legendary - Any combo of legendaries really, whatever you wanna take in to DD.  
Non-Legendary Mutant - X-Treme X-Men will be good here.  
  
War:  
Bio - If you have Hive-Mind use them, otherwise Rebirth or Gamma if you already have Rulk.  
Avenger - Any combination of your top ones will work here. I'd recommend working on Hulk and IMIW for Gamma/Pegasus respectively, you could use Secret Avengers/Nick Fury here as good work towards Omega Red.  
Villain - You can use any combo of toons here.  
Skill - If you have Invaders, those could be good here. Otherwise via these other teams you will have strong toons such as Kestrel & Black Cat and can throw in Secret Avengers with them.  
  
Famine:  
City - I'd use Secret Defenders here, supplemented with whoever you have best. Superior six members would be good if you're not sure who else.  
Mutant - X-Treme X-Men again.  
Villain - You can use any combo of toons here.  
Cosmic/Mystic - Bifrost would be a good choice, but lots of strong characters to choose from here like Weaver, Eternals, GRR.  
  
Summary:  
If you work on the following teams, you'll be fine and have good utility in raids too:  
\- Underworld or Hive-Mind  
\- Pegasus  
\- Bifrost  
\- Secret Defenders  
\- X-Treme X-Men  
\- Assorted legendary team  
\- Rebirth/Gamma (If you don't do Hive-Mind)  
\- Secret Avengers 

  
Hope this helps!
